items:
"JUST ADD WATER"
✨ Luxury 5-Bedroom Retreat in Seacrest Beach – Private Pool, Lagoon Access & Steps to 30A ✨

Experience elevated coastal living in this beautifully designed 5-bedroom home in the heart of Seacrest Beach. With expansive porches, a private heated pool, and easy access to the beach, this retreat offers the perfect blend of comfort and luxury for families and groups.
-----------------------------------------------------

🏡 PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS

Private Heated Pool with dining area & gas grill (additional $50/night for pool heating)

1-Minute Walk to the 12,000 sq. ft. Seacrest Lagoon Pool

5-Minute Tram Ride to the beach

Wrap-Around Porches & Balconies for morning coffee or evening relaxation
Accommodates Up to 18 Guests

Chef’s Gourmet Kitchen with premium appliances

Over 4,000 sq. ft. of beautifully designed indoor space
----------------------------------------------------------------------

-- LIVING SPACES --

Bright, open-concept living area designed for gathering and relaxing.

Plush, stylish furnishings

Large smart TV

Abundant natural light throughout
-------------------------------------------------------

--🍽️ KITCHEN & DINING --

A chef-inspired kitchen perfect for family meals or entertaining.

High-end stainless steel appliances

Spacious island with seating

Dining table for 6 + additional bar seating
-------------------------------------------------------

--🌴 PRIVATE OUTDOOR ESCAPE --

Your own resort-style outdoor area awaits.

Heated private pool (seasonal)

Poolside dining area and gas grill

Expansive wrap-around porches with lounge seating
--------------------------------------------------------------------

--🛏️ BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS --

-----1st Floor-----

King Primary Suite w/ en-suite bathroom

Half bathroom for common areas

---- 2nd Floor ------

King Primary Suite – En-suite bath

Bunk Room – Full over Full w/ shared bath

Double Bedroom – Two double beds w/ shared bath

Sitting Area – Twin bunk bed

Jack-and-Jill shared bathroom

-------3rd Floor--------

Full Nook – Double bed

King Primary Suite – En-suite bathroom w/ tub/shower combo
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

LOCATION & COMMUNITY

Situated in the desirable Seacrest Beach community with walkability to everything 30A offers.

12,000 sq. ft. Lagoon Pool with waterfalls, zero-entry sections & lush surroundings - ONE MINUTE WALK

Beach Access via seasonal tram or 10-minute walk

Walk or Bike to Rosemary Beach, Alys Beach & Peddler’s Pavilion

Boutiques, dining, live music & nightlife minutes away

Scenic nature trails steps from the home

Approximate Distances:

Rosemary Beach – 8-minute walk

Alys Beach – 12-minute walk

Carillon Beach – 7-minute drive
----------------------------------------------
GOOD TO KNOW

No wire transfers accepted

LSVs not allowed in Seacrest, Rosemary Beach, or Alys Beach

Must sign bike waiver before receiving lock code

Sunset Beach boardwalk closed Jan 2–mid-Feb 2026 (use Inlet Beach Public Access)

Pool heating available! ($50/night additional charge for pool heating)

Guests will be provided a 'starter' pack of amenities, but may need to purchase additional items for longer stays. We provide each bathroom with: 2 rolls of Toilet paper per bathroom, travel size shampoo, conditioner, body wash, and bar soap.

Guests may want to bring your own pool/beach towels, and beach chairs. We do not offer them as we can't guarantee a quality experience from guest to guest on these items. (bath towels are provided for in home use)

Coffee; provided are both a Keurig (single pod) machine and a traditional coffee pot - guests to provide own K-cups or grinds
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.

description: Located by the sea, this vacation home is in Rosemary Beach, a neighborhood in Panama City Beach. Shoppers can check out Pier Park, while everyone can enjoy the natural beauty of Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach. Frank Brown Park and Sundog Books are also worth visiting. Discover the area's water adventures with motor boating nearby, or enjoy the great outdoors with ecotours and horse riding.

reviews.text: We had an amazing spring break at this house!! While you can see how adorable and spacious it is from the pictures, here are some other things we loved. 1- The proximity to the square. The kids loved the freedom of quick walks or bike rides to shop, eat, & listen to music. This house being at the front of the neighborhood is a perk for sure! 2- The heated pool!!! We had some unfortunate cold weather this spring break and the heated private pool was a game changer!!
